reason: I already pay for English mind-reading apps, but a Hebrew one I can hand to an Israeli spectator at a birthday is something I actually lack, and 99 ₪ once is nothing next to what one gig pays me. I'd try the free tricks first and buy the same evening if they hold up.
objection: How long does it take to learn and set up, and will a browser-installed app that isn't from the App Store work every time in front of an audience, with no glitch or giveaway on the spectator's own phone search?
would_change_my_mind: If the free tricks lag, look fake, or take more than about 20 minutes to get performance-ready, I'd drop it and stick with the apps I already own.
